Subject: Kickoff: Renewal & Expansion MAP for Acme Corporation (Q2 timeline)

Hi Elena, Jordan —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our renewal conversation, we put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align on the renewal + expansion milestones and a proposed evaluation plan for Acme’s new feature pilot. The goal of this thread is to introduce roles, confirm success criteria, and lock a close window so we can prioritize capacity and enable the upsell path to Redwood Dedicated.

High-level goals:
- Renewal: ensure current subscription (hosted API) renews with standard Enterprise terms by end of Q2.
- Expansion: pilot Dedicated shard for inference on the new recommendation workload (target 3k TPS peak).
- Evaluation: run a 4-week pilot with PK/latency SLAs and quality gates tied to the evaluation prompt set.

Proposed owners (please confirm or suggest alternates):
- Customer Exec Sponsor: Elena Garcia (Acme)
- Technical Lead (customer): Jordan Lee (Acme)
- Redwood Sales Exec: Marissa Cole
- Redwood Solutions / CS: Monica Patel (pilot ops, onboarding)
- Redwood Performance Lead: Grace O'Connor (benchmarks, SLOs)
- Legal / Procurement contact (Redwood): Vivek Kulkarni

Draft timeline (proposed):
1) 2/17 — MAP review & signoff (confirm resources, add missing stakeholders)
2) 3/1 — Pilot kickoff (baseline usage/day, config, onboarding sessions)
3) 3/29 — Pilot completion: results shared (latency, cost, quality metrics)
4) 4/5 — Commercial decision (renew + Dedicated sizing)

Evaluation plan summary:
- Signals: throughput, p95 latency, token cost per request, rerank quality (A/B vs baseline prompts)
- Acceptance criteria: p95 < 350ms on 8k token KV-cache workflow, no more than 10% quality regression on the benchmark prompts
- Data/Access: Redwood hosted logs + S3 export; we will provide a usage report at the end of each week.

Attachments: I uploaded a starter MAP workbook (Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx) and current usage summary (Acme_usage_q1_2026.pdf).

Next steps: please confirm owners and the 2/17 MAP review slot (I’m proposing 10:00–10:45 PT). If you’d like a different review cadence or an extended pilot window, flag it here.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Marissa
